{{Quote|From what we've been able to gather, the Revanites' agents in the Empire and Republic have been feeding the Nova Blades intel on ship activity. The Blades then use that intel to ambush military patrols and key shipping lanes on both sides. They're essentially remapping hyperroutes.|[[Theron Shan]]|<ref name="Shadow" />}}
The '''Nova Blades''' were a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that were based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] in the decades before the [[Galactic War]]. Originally a loose conglomerate of pirate crews that shared resources, the Blades eventually joined together and began to collaborate tactically, extensively preying on [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperroutes]]&mdash;to the point where many corporations established a line item known as the "Blade Tax" to account for the expected losses due to the Blades' attacks. The [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Aggressor (Rishi)|''Aggressor'']] was a major part of the Blades' forces, but when the Blades attempted a [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] journey to the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]] dwarf [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] over a century before the Galactic War, the ''Aggressor'' crashed on Rishi, where [[Ralen Margok]] spearheaded an effort to turn the wreck into a headquarters.

==History==
By the [[Galactic War]] in [[3637 BBY]], the Blades were led by [[Dael Margok]] and allied themselves with the [[Order of Revan]], who assigned them to perform hit-and-run attacks on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] patrol routes to remap [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to force command fleets on both sides to Rishi. They also built a signal jammer on Rishi to scramble all communications for when the Republic and Imperial fleets arrived, leaving them with no way to coordinate as Revanite saboteurs and the Revanite fleet wiped them out. However, Margok incidentally alienated [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla's]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan, who refused to aid the Revanites' machinations.

In the same year, the Blades were being harassed by an upstart pirate gang, losing several weapon stockpiles and the slave camp. Margok contacted [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] directly for aid, but the Revanite leader declared that the Nova Blades had reached the end of their usefulness and demanded that Margok deal with his new rivals before resuming any talk of alliance. Unknown to both sides, the rival pirate gang was a mere fabrication created by [[Theron Shan]], [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Jakarro]] in an attempt to thwart the Revanites' plan. With the aid of a spacer posing as the representative of the pirate gang, they assaulted the ''Aggressor'' to recover whatever intel the Blades had on the Revanites, killing Margok in the process and leaving the surviving Blades leaderless.

In [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TOR updates|5.10.3}}</ref> the Nova Blades were contracted by the Sith Empire to [[Dantooine Incursion|attack]] the Republic on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], but eventually the gang members turned on the Empire and assaulted the assets of both factions.<ref name="Dantooine">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|The Marauders of Dantooine|Dantooine}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Yarvok]] of the Nova Blades seized control of the [[Banir Regional Energy Complex|Dantooine Power Station]] and asked for 15 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]]. The power station was quickly besieged by Republic and Imperial forces and a spacer drove off Yarvok and cleared the building of Nova Blades.<ref name="RR">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=heroic|Reactor Ransom|Dantooine}}</ref>

The pirates deployed a [[prototype assault walker]] which they had stolen from a [[Factory/Legends|weapons-testing facility]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. A spacer was tasked to destroy the experimental vehicle before it could fall into the hands of either the Republic or Empire.<ref name="SNT">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=heroic|Shiny New Toy|Dantooine}}</ref>

Nova Blades were holding [[Slavery/Legends|slave auctions]] for selling those captured during their pillaging. One of such was guarded by the infamous [[exoboar]] [[Hugo (exoboar)|Hugo]] and terminated by an adventurous spacer.<ref name="Hugo">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=heroic|Beware Of Hugo|Dantooine}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

By [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="TOR Dates Forums2">{{TOR updates|6.1}}</ref> law had been established on Rishi under the [[Tribunal (Rishi)|Tribunal]]. The Nova Blades attempted to sabotage their efforts and return Raider's Cove to a pirate center but were stopped by a [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] envoy, seeking the support of Tribunal members to establish one such feast on Rishi.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Sharing Our Bounty|Rishi}}</ref>
